description: Default capability set for the Cloaksession Tauri shell. Grants the frontend access to the core Tauri APIs (window, webview, event, app, path, image) and to the dialog plugin (used by `dialog_pick_browser_binary` / `dialog_pick_directory`). IPC commands themselves (the `#[tauri::command]` handlers in `commands/`) do NOT require capability entries — Tauri 2.x restricts core/plugin APIs, not user-defined commands.
